title: Slider
description: Pick a number in a range by dragging: one thumb, or two with range for a min–max pair.
when: Values where the position matters more than the exact number (volume, opacity, infill, price range filters).
a11y: role="slider" per thumb with aria-valuenow / aria-valuetext (format): arrows step, PageUp / PageDown jump, Home / End go to the ends.
